decision_summary: V5 Epic 4 E-4-2b final advisory seal promotes the tenant isolation matrix from placeholder state to filled state, binds seven dimensions to existing downstream evidence refs, preserves advisory-only constants, and records a 3-provider quorum with OpenAI/Codex implementation plus independent Anthropic/Claude and MiniMax/Mavis reviews. It does not mutate workflows, claim runtime enforcement, claim live validation, widen support, claim production platform readiness, or execute live adapters.

implementation_evidence.notes: Codex/OpenAI implemented the E-4-2b final seal in this PR; OpenAI self-review is not counted as independent release evidence.

review_evidence.notes: Claude CLI review returned VERDICT: AGREE and verified lifecycle, downstream refs, advisory constants, no overclaim language, no live cluster commands, schema/test shape, and boundary discipline.

Mavis/MiniMax review identified the missing evidence JSON and pre-commit write-set mismatch; those findings were absorbed by adding this evidence artifact and making write-set detection include committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked files.

notes: AI output is evidence only; release authority remains ao-release-gate plus GitHub ruleset enforcement.
The final seal is advisory only and does not authorize production platform claim, support widening, or live adapter execution.
Resource quota remains operator-applied; the matrix ref to values.yaml covers pod resource requests/limits only, not a rendered ResourceQuota manifest.
Namespace and RBAC refs bind to E-4-1 chart skeleton because those boundaries are chart foundation behavior rather than E-4-3/E-4-4/E-4-5 follow-up artifacts.
E-4-2b updates the parent Epic 4 plan only to record the actual provider-role model for this PR; no runtime or workflow scope is widened.
